title: Closed and Irreducible Polynomials in Several Variables
exact_import: Theorem 1, implication (i) to (iii): a noncomposite polynomial f has C[f] integrally closed in the ambient polynomial algebra.
portions_inspected: Section 2, Definition 1 and Theorem 1; Proposition 1 and its proof of the imported implication; Lemma 3 and its denominator-clearing proof relating polynomial closedness to relative algebraic closedness of C(f).
role: An explicit proof input for relative algebraic closedness of a nowhere-critical polynomial parameter. The no-composition argument, the field denominator step (also in the source Lemma 3), finite-cover disjointness and the class-monodromy application are written in the new note.
